records=[];objects=[]
for x in notices:

 day=pd.Timestamp(x['ledger_date']);pre=int(dates.searchsorted(day,side='left'))-1;nextix=int(dates.searchsorted(day,side='right'));same=int(dates.searchsorted(day,side='left'))
 sameix=same if same<len(dates) and dates[same]==day else None
 cats=x['specific_reason_categories'];group='MIXED_TAGS' if len(cats)>1 else cats[0] if cats else x['reason_status']
 obj=[]
 for a in x['specific_reason_anchors']:
  q=a['sentence'];mlf=('MLF' in q or '中期借贷便利' in q);repo='逆回购' in q
  subject='JOINT_MLF_AND_REVERSE_REPO_OR_BANK_LIQUIDITY' if mlf and repo else 'MLF_OR_OTHER_TERM_OPERATION_TEXT' if mlf else 'REVERSE_REPO_TEXT' if repo else 'BANK_LIQUIDITY_STATE_OR_CONSTRAINT_TEXT'
  obj.append({'sentence':q,'actual_literal_subject':subject,'original_tags':a['categories'],'tax_peak_passed_literal':bool('税期' in q and ('已过' in q or '结束' in q)),'cash_injection_literal':'现金投放' in q,'cash_return_literal':bool('现金' in q and '回笼' in q)})
 objects.append({'notice_date':x['ledger_date'],'raw_path':x['raw_path'],'source_url':x['source_url'],'original_reason_status':x['reason_status'],'original_tags':cats,'word_tag_group':group,'all_original_anchors':obj,'tags_not_pure_causes':True})
 endpoints={'H0':sameix,'H1':nextix if nextix<len(dates) else None,'H5':nextix+4 if nextix+4<len(dates) else None}
 for h,ix in endpoints.items():
  baseline=float(values[pre]) if pre>=0 else None

f=pd.DataFrame(records);assert len(objects)==sum(z['target_object'] for z in notices) and len(f)==3*len(objects)
f.to_csv(OUT/'全部常规公告_H0_H1_H5原DR路径.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig');save('所有原公告理由句作用对象_词类非纯原因.json',objects)

 v=g.change_bp.dropna();a=v.to_numpy(float)
 return {'n_announcements':len(g),'known_paths':len(v),'unknown_paths':int(g.change_bp.isna().sum()),'mean_bp':float(v.mean()) if len(v) else None,'median_bp':float(v.median()) if len(v) else None,'positive_paths':int((v>0).sum()),'negative_paths':int((v<0).sum()),'zero_paths':int((v==0).sum()),'minimum_bp':float(v.min()) if len(v) else None,'maximum_bp':float(v.max()) if len(v) else None,'not_causal_or_independent_samples':True}

pd.DataFrame(groups).to_csv(OUT/'全部词类组_H0_H1_H5均值中位与反例.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')

mixed_subject_uses=sum(a['actual_literal_subject']=='MLF_OR_OTHER_TERM_OPERATION_TEXT' for z in objects for a in z['all_original_anchors'])

save('result.json',result)
for z in pro['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
recomputed=[]
for h,g in f.groupby('horizon',sort=False):
 assert len(g)==len(objects)
 known=g.dropna(subset=['change_bp'])
 assert np.allclose(known.change_bp,(known.response_dr007_percent-known.baseline_dr007_percent)*100,rtol=0,atol=1e-10)
 recomputed.append({'horizon':h,'known':len(known),'unknown':int(g.change_bp.isna().sum()),'unit_identity_passed':True})
save('保存结果必要核对.json',{'at':now(),'status':'PASS_ORIGINAL_POPULATION_FIXED_HORIZONS_RATE_IDENTITY_UNITS_AND_PARENT_HASHES','source_announcement_objects':len(objects),'fixed_rate_path_rows':len(f),'all_three_horizons':recomputed,'original_groups_not_changed_after_response':True,'stock_labels_or_prices_read':False,'new_models':0,'new_accounts':0,'original_parents_unchanged':True,'not_independent_or_causal_validation':True})
